stages.name: Learn about the scholarship

doing.value: Reviews information on the OSI website and KualiBuild form after hearing about the scholarship through the website, email, Blink website, Teams channels, or newsletters.

wants.value: Understand the scholarship opportunity and what is needed to apply.

touchpoints.value: OSI website; KualiBuild form; emails; Blink website; Teams channels; newsletters; live informational session.

stages.duration: Application window is typically about 1 month.

stages.name: Develop and discuss a project idea

doing.value: Thinks about and documents the process they will work on during the class, using a Word document or notes, and reviews the process with their supervisor before applying.

wants.value: Identify a process to work on and discuss it with their supervisor.

touchpoints.value: Supervisor; project notes or Word document; live informational session.

waitingFor.value: Supervisor review before filling out the application form.

doing.value: Clicks the KualiBuild link and fills out the required fields, including name, supervisor information, process details, data, and pain points, then submits the form.

wants.value: Submit the application with information that helps the evaluation committee understand whether the process fits the class.

waitingFor.value: The supervisor notification and additional supervisor steps after submission.

doing.value: The applicant's supervisor acknowledges awareness of the application, gives a recommendation, and addresses support for classwork and project time during work hours.

wants.value: Have supervisor support for taking the class and working on the project.

touchpoints.value: KualiBuild notification to the supervisor; supervisor application step.

doing.value: Waits while the application window closes and the evaluation committee reviews and scores submissions using a rubric and evaluation guide, followed by an additional review of the overall set of awards.

touchpoints.value: KualiBuild form; evaluation committee; rubric; evaluation guide.

waitingFor.value: The application window to close, committee review, scoring, and agreement on how many scholarships can be awarded.

doing.value: Receives a customized email notifying them whether they were awarded or not awarded a scholarship.

wants.value: Know the outcome of the application.

touchpoints.value: Customized email sent through the KualiBuild form.

stages.name: Set up enrollment and join the awardee session

doing.value: If awarded, contacts or works with the DES program manager to set up a student account and register for the class term, then attends an informational meeting with awardees, OSI, and the DES program manager.

wants.value: Register for the class, understand what is needed moving forward, meet other awardees, and know that OSI and DES are available as resources.

touchpoints.value: DES program manager; student account; class registration; meeting with awardees, OSI, and DES program manager.

thinkingFeeling.value: The session is intended to help awardees understand that they are not alone and can rely on OSI as a resource.

waitingFor.value: Direction from the DES program manager about setting up an account and registering for a class term.

stages.duration: The kickoff meeting takes about 1 hour.

stages.name: Take the class and work on the project

doing.value: Takes the class and works on the process project, with the expectation that time is blocked for both classwork and project work.

wants.value: Complete the class and project with supervisor support for the required time.

touchpoints.value: UC San Diego Division of Extended Studies; supervisor; OSI as a resource.

stages.duration: Follow-up occurs over approximately 3 to 9 months while students are taking the classes; the overall process is roughly 6 months.

stages.name: Present the project and report outcomes

doing.value: Delivers a final presentation, sends the presentation and related details to OSI, and meets with OSI to discuss process changes and estimate financial impacts for the savings tracker and dashboards.

wants.value: Share how the project went and provide the project and financial outcome details.

touchpoints.value: Final presentation; OSI; OSI Excel impact savings tracker; meeting with OSI.

thinkingFeeling.value: Candidates are often not skilled at measuring financial impacts and may feel they do not know how to make the calculation or do not have enough data to validate it.

waitingFor.value: The project to finish and the final presentation; OSI follow-up to quantify the impact.

stages.duration: The individual follow-up meeting takes about 30 minutes to 1 hour; projects finish about 3 to 6 months later, with 3 to 9 months of potential follow-up.
